notes.title: Beta V 0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Notes: For this update the focus is on new features such as newspaer storyline chapters, customer reactions ("gossip?"), terrace area, new creature NPCs, gameplay and controller adjustments and more.

Beta 0.1 patch release:

September 6th, 2025


NEW:

Newspaper Storyline: All newspaper articles have been added and organized into chapters.

NPC Gossip: NPCs now react and “gossip” based on the newspaper article of the day.

Expanded Dialogue: Additional dialogue interactions with NPCs tied to progression.

New Creature NPCs: New characters introduced to the world.

Terrace Area: Terrace and related upgrades are now available.

NPC Terrace Behavior: NPCs will now hang out on the terrace once unlocked.

River Rewards: Miscellaneous items can now be caught in the river for extra rewards.

Pastry Tooltips: Pastry inventory now shows detailed tooltips.

Pastry Management: Auto-add and auto-remove all pastries from inventory to display.

Gameplay Adjustments:

Build mode can now be used while the café is open.

Time pauses when build mode is active.

Player can now go to sleep anytime, as long as the café has been opened and closed that day.

Time remains paused until the café is opened.

Customer waiting time increased to allow latte art to be completed at a reasonable pace.

A limit on active decor orders has been added.

Pastries can now only be ordered during the day.

Controller:

Visual controller UI instructions added (with gamepad detection).

Cursor sensitivity decreased during latte art.

Brewing panel navigation sensitivity fixed.

Zoom sensitivity is now based on stick input rather than one fixed speed.

Cancel keybind selection added in settings.

Fixes:

Main menu button text sometimes not appearing.

Parsley NPC sitting animation fixed.

Orders filling automatically on Day 1 without any customers.

“Sell Items” section in the shop now correctly displays selected item information.

Fixed pastry displays being placeable in the bedroom.

Fireplace lag on first ignition resolved.

Fixed customers not spawning after max level was reached.

Cups no longer remain stuck on pastry displays.

Matcha whisk freezing when exiting the brewing panel fixed.

Navigation error when no pastries are available to buy for the day fixed.

Navigation skipping the hot chocolate heater in the brewing panel fixed.

Other:

Miscellaneous UI edits.

Added new SFX (café opening, wrong coffee order, etc.).

NPC section in the journal now shows which day each NPC unlocks.

Locked newspaper articles are now visible in the journal.

NPC collision removed to prevent them from getting stuck.

New scene transition animations.

Terrace ambience sounds added.

Sandbox time slider replaced with a day/night toggle.

Bedroom window is now openable.

Miscellaneous keyboard and controller adjustments.

Extended the café and sandbox soundtracks.

notes.title: General Update (Aug 2025)
notes.content:
🎉 Game developing progress!
It’s been a little while since I shared the first Alpha and playtest versions of the game, and I’ve been quietly working on monthly updates, polishing features, and listening closely to your feedback. This update is a little reflection on where the game is currently now and where it's heading!

 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e84640f96080e67bc6b8b1ced1d443488ceb8204.gif"]

 
☕️ Looking Back: The First Alpha Milestone
The very first Alpha release launched with the foundation of what will be Tailside’s Early Access experience. Here's what was already up and running back then:



🟢 Expanded different drink recipes: 8/8 COMPLETED

🟢 Expanded decor: COMPLETED

🟢 Village (NPC) customers: COMPLETED

🟢 Day and night cycle: COMPLETED

🟢 Bedroom area: COMPLETED

🟢 Accessibility: Missing Day & Night cycle length setting COMPLETED

🟢 Save & Load system: COMPLETED

🟢 Controller support: COMPLETED


Since that release, these features have continued to evolve, improving based on your playtest feedback. From polish and visual clarity to control and comfort, everyone's input has shaped every corner of the experience.


☕️ Growing Beyond the Plan
As development progressed, Tailside expanded far beyond its original scope. New features, many not part of the original roadmap, have found their way into the game, more than doubling the planned content:

🟢 Skill Tree: COMPLETED

🟢 Custom Character Import: COMPLETED

🟢 Shop & Delivery System: COMPLETED

🟢 Brewing and Cafe upgrades: COMPLETED

🟢 Newspaper storyline: COMPLETED

🟢 Journal: COMPLETED

🟢 Pastry buying & selling: COMPLETED



Some of these were born from spontaneous inspiration, others from cozy community suggestions and I'm happy the alpha testers have been enjoying them so far as well!


☕️ Next update content
It seems that since last alpha update, there's not that much issues to fix, so I have been already working towards next update this week with new things while another dev is helping fix up some issues around:

🟢 Mini storyline chapters through newspaper making the game feel somewhat like having a start and end

🟢 Characters will have speech bubble reactions in general once approached and also reactions to current day's newspaper

🟢 Terrace area preview

🟢 UI adjusted to controller displays instead of only keyboard/mouse so all the players with controllers can have proper instructions

🔴 And then the last thing that is missing now before the next update would be some gameplay adjustments to match the newspaper and terrace additions so it actually makes sense in the game haha and of course some retesting to make sure it's all playable.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/d57e391d203d1ec3f1dd8b8d92e39d4319886ee0.gif"]

☕️ Debut Festival 2025: August 7–11
Tailside will be part of a special Steam festival event "Debut Festival 2025" from August 7–11! This event features various game developers that are debutting their first games. During the time of this festival, Tailside Demo together with the Sandbox Playtest will be available to play.


☕️ Thank You for Being Here
Whether you played the Alpha, shared a kind word, wishlisted, or just quietly followed along, thank you. Your support means the world to this small café in the woods.



If you would like to be part of the development journey, you can vote on various ideas on:
Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Leave your own suggestions
Thank you so much for the support - Coffee Beans Dev

notes.title: Alpha V 0.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Notes: For this update the focus is on new features such as few upgrades, pastries addition and new journal and recipe book informational sections. 

Alpha 0.1.3 Update
June 25th, 2025


NEW:

Upgrades & Guide Section: A new upgrades menu and a guide section have been added to the recipe book.

Brewing & Café Upgrades: Several upgrades are now available.

Pastry Ordering & Selling: This feature can now be unlocked via the upgrade system.

New Journal Sections: Added sections for Characters, Level Overviews, and Newspaper Logs.

Alpha Tester Shortcuts: Alpha testers can now use “cheat codes” by pressing “L” to level up and “K” to add 1000 coins, making testing faster for everyone.

Sleep Anytime: The player can now go to sleep at any time.

Recipe Book Access: Now accessible directly from the café counter (useful when the café is closed).

Customer Behavior Update: Customers will now leave the café after waiting too long for their order, making the environment more dynamic.



Fixes:

Adjusted scroll speed in the order and inventory selling panels.

Fixed inactive toggle for door opening/closing.

Fixed chairs overlapping incorrectly under tables.

Fixed carpets being placeable over the terrace door.

Volume bar in settings now provides sound feedback when adjusted.

Fixed inventory filter not updating in build mode after selling items.

Fixed certain decor items not appearing in the sell panel.

Fixed incorrect inventory amounts showing in the sell panel after repurchasing a sold item.

Fixed infinite money glitch when selling items that didn't properly reduce inventory.

Fixed skills not being applied correctly on game load.

Fixed custom characters reverting to Toffee’s sprite when pausing.

Fixed item outlines staying active on walls.

Fixed NPCs walking backward.

Added missing controller navigation in the build mode info pop-up.

Fixed skill tooltips appearing under the mouse instead of above the skill if using the keyboard navigation instead.

Fixed build mode navigation when no items are left in the inventory.

Fixed settings not accessible after loading a game.

Fixed performance issues with build mode item filters.



Other:

Corrected earnings from selling decor items currently on sale.

Moved the daily goal bar to the right side of the brewing panel.

Added a small bounce animation to brewing and milk heating.

Light (lamp) decor items can now be toggled with the mouse as well as the keyboard.

Added new guide panels with clearer gameplay instructions.

Added WASD movement and zoom instructions in build mode.

Added a toggle for QWERTY and AZERTY control schemes in settings.

Added instructions for pouring latte art.

Changed decor item sorting to appear on the left instead of the center for easier order management.

notes.title: Alpha V 0.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Notes:
This update mostly focuses on a few known alpha bugs and on the build (decor) mode system as it’s a big part of the game, I want to ensure it’s enjoyable.

Alpha 0.1.2 Update & Fixes

 Fixed tips timer appearing when there is no order.
 Fixed cafe counters not appearing in build mode inventory when in the bedroom (buttons remain disabled since cafe counters only exist in the cafe).
 Fixed ordered items not showing up in inventory.
 Added new NPC appearances as you progress through the days in the game.

 Fixed floors, wallpapers, and cafe counters appearing in the shop even after being purchased.
 Added a missing panel slider in the shop orders panel.

notes.title: Devlog #008 (Feb 2025)
notes.content:
Game is expanding!
Gameplay has been expanded with a new shop and order system, completed major NPC customers, and a skill tree that lets you customize your coffee-making experience! The first alpha version is approaching quickly, with an estimated release at the end of March as planned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/27f7fa0e7d6cecf00f2a37a7ccb91c54b0fa1201.gif

☕️ Shop & Orders
(Functional! UI design in progress..)

The new shop system has finally arrived, making your shopping experience much more interactive! While the initial design only allowed for immediate one  by one purchases, the new system lets players view current inventory counts, buy in bulk, and filter through all available items. After making your selections, you'll place a package order that takes some time to be delivered.

And yes, you can now finally sell your items, too! Especially if you're tired of that boring free chair you got at the start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/f387712167f6b186c306b4625838bea9caa4fc12.gif

☕️ Skill tree
To add a layer of strategy to coffee making while keeping it simple, a skill tree has been introduced! As you level up and earn skill points, you’ll be able to unlock new coffee recipes, increase the XP gained from them, reduce brewing and grinding times, and gain other bonuses.

While you can’t unlock all skills at once, you’ll have the option to reset them anytime, allowing you to refine your own perfect brewing experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/a3ff508348ab07c6858cd3fde29e9c473b4999e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/75e60fbc628f3fcc4355118d1e7da14eaca5e78f.gif

☕️ NPC Customer System 
Last time, we mentioned adding big NPCs as customers to the café, and since then, this feature has been completed, with new characters now fully imported!

The number of customers depends on your level and the availability of chairs. To add more structure to the decoration system, chairs can now only be placed next to tables. While NPCs aren’t interactable just yet, I have some fun ideas for future improvements, maybe even making you eagerly anticipate visits from your favorite characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/b888bfdc18c5948a6291661fea4a241134e3b883.gif

☕️ Decor expansion
Decor item assets up to level 30 have been completed and are ready to be implemented in the game! This means players can now level up to 30 instead of being limited to 10. The current goal is to expand the game further, eventually reaching level 50.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/384c0920c64d9b96c65c431597a098e8e0770225.png

☕️ Completed 8/8 drinks
The planned eight drink recipes have now been added, expanding the game from the original three coffee drinks to a total of eight, along with a few related minigames!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/765b3f5ca5d6beed48bf608bfd3146593e93f269.gif

🛠️ Other edits & fixes:

 Fixed a bug not allowing to proceed with dialogues at the introduction
 Added "Save & Exit" options when exiting the game or to the main menu
 Fixed money additions showing "+0"
 Gameplay increase to level 30 from 10
 Slight UI adjustments of level and time info for better visibility
 New NPC introduction dialogue added
 Fixed hovering over empty milk showing full milk sprite
 Fixed no orders showing but still gaining money and experience while completing some drinks
 Added setting to choose day length
 Added current item orders & skills to save system
 Fixed the layering issue of plants appearing on top of NPCs when placed on tables


If you would like to be part of the development journey, you can vote on various ideas on:
Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Leave your own suggestions
Thank you so much for the support - Coffee Beans Dev

notes.title: Devlog #007 (Dec-Jan 2024)
notes.content:
After the long December holidays and an even longer January, development on Tailside is back with further updates!
While the holiday season served as a rest period for the team, progress continued with new features and further work on the first private alpha version, to be tested together with fundraiser participants. The project remains on track to release the alpha version in Q1 of this year. As of this writing, the alpha version is approximately 60% complete. Here's an overview of the latest progress:

☕️ Completed Bedroom Addition
The bedroom area has been completed, featuring its own soundtrack. This will be the place to relax and prepare for a new workday. And yes, it can be decorated too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/03aa74b2c80e668d50280625e0b17ae32da76a97.gif

☕️ Completed Day & Night System
Alongside the bedroom, the day & night system is now fully implemented. At the end of each day, a summary will display key statistics and bonuses earned throughout the work hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/0bf8ef5764e726697998e517eb95e627ca936224.gif

☕️ UI and Game Animation Polishing
Between other tasks, additional polishing touches are being tested for the UI and game animations to improve responsiveness and overall usability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/16b77a4a3749291ebc61ffc153b08fdc90020fe2.gif {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/c081e01cc8403aa12725e890b0aaa7392c24a6a0.gif 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/2e74e76800c6602b2bc21a47683f496da970be22.gif

☕️ Completed Save & Load System
A save & load system is now fully functional, offering three save slots for creating different café experiences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/3c5d35379604a23804b92a6d2fbb4bf908938faa.gif

☕️ Ongoing Work on NPC Customer System
One of the largest features currently in development is the NPC customer system. While tiny customers were already present, friendly villager NPCs will soon begin visiting as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/f80b25b9190a3c8d761fbc1c8f10b037d33b5f81.gif

☕️ Localization Volunteering
Though not initially planned, localization may be added with the help of volunteers. Efforts are underway to make Tailside more accessible to non-English-speaking players.

Anyone interested in contributing can fill out this form with their native language.. We appreciate all the effort the community is putting into this!

☕️ Soundtrack DLC
The first set of soundtracks featured in early access has been completed, and the soundtrack DLC is now ready for setup. Fundraiser participants will receive the soundtrack before the game's release.

☕️ Custom Character Import
The main character is fully customizable! The alpha version will allow testing of the custom character import system, enabling players to personalize their protagonist for a more unique experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/510075eb46f58f5d157a6e09c0bd2894e04315c0.gif

🛠️ Other edits & fixes:

 Fixed zoom issues on UI elements
 Fixed zoom in/out functionality in windowed mode when the mouse is not over the game
 Latte art mini-game now supports controllers and full keyboard input
 Fixed an NPC not appearing when "Skip Introduction" is activated
 Fixed orders not being enabled after dialogue ends
 Recipe book now opens automatically when introduced for the first time
 Fixed "End of Playtest" and the final task of the game
 Added a text UI animation displaying money increases and decreases
 Added a text UI animation showing experience gain
 Placing items now includes a small bounce animation
 Improved level-up UI animations to showcase new unlocked items one by one
 Fixed an issue preventing empty cups from being cleaned after the café closes
 Fixed some inventory items not displaying their quantities


If you would like to be part of the development journey, you can vote on various ideas on:
Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Leave your own suggestions
Thank you so much for the support - Coffee Beans Dev

notes.title: Devlog #006 (Oct-Nov 2024)
notes.content:
🏆 Highlight of Oct-Nov: Fundraiser wrap up
Tailside has been funded for it's EA launch with fundraiser raising over 40.000 EUR to make it happen! From a total of 900+ Backers there is now also around 110 custom items expected to be added to the game from cute little pastries to NPCs. All with a purpose in the game to improve the interactibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/ff4d378de7eb16758fcc915064c432eebda68b36.png

Now, even more exciting news. During the fundraiser we had various stretch goals to reach to expand Tailside with new features and we have reached quite a few of them. Here are the list of stretch goals that community has funded and that are now guaranteed to be added in the Early Access launch:

Sandbox mode:
This mode unlocks endless possibilities for players to decorate multiple cafes with no restrictions. Design your perfect cafe, share it with friends and fellow cafe owners. Should we feature the best ones?

Cafe Terrace area:
The cafe terrace expansion adds a beautiful customizable outdoor area where customers can sip coffee under the sun, enjoy a scenic view, and experience a whole new feeling.

Plushie Decor Set:
Transform your cafe into the ultimate cozy haven with an exclusive Plushie Decor Set or use it to decorate your own personal bedroom space! This collection of cozy plushies adds a warm, welcoming touch, creating the perfect place for customers and yourself to relax and enjoy.

Greenhouse:
Grow and process your own coffee ingredients, buy mysterious seeds and discover new plants. These can be used to decorate your cafe or even become part of your cafe’s revenue - if your customers are interested in taking home a beautiful plant of their own.

Soundtrack DLC:
Original Tailside soundtrack DLC will be produced and added as a free reward for all backers. Experience the cozy ambiance of Tailside cafe wherever you are! This exclusive Soundtrack DLC offers backers a collection of relaxing, heartwarming tunes straight from the game.

Twitch integration:
Make your cafe even more interactive with Twitch integration! This feature allows players streaming on Twitch to interact directly with their viewers. Fullfil orders of the viewers, get extra coins, rewards and more.

🏆 30.000 Wishlists milestone!
During the fundraiser event, Tailside has reached a total of 30.000 wishlists, can't believe how many of you have Tailside in your lists of games you have at least a little bit of interest


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/3016b8cf2e671ad7d102204186401c159edd9644.gif

On these great notes, the Early Access version development has already started and here's some overview on the current work through the initial EA features before moving to the unlocked fundraiser stretch goals:

☕️ Day and night cycle
Gameplay is now expanding into Day & Night and weekdays cycle. With that we are adding more brewing involvement through timed bonuses and other mini games, on-work and off-work hours to differentiate the time between work and relaxation such as decoration your cafe, bedroom and terrace zones.

☕️ New NPCs revealed
There will be a total of 10 NPCs to meet in the EA version, plus a few visitors by the fundraiser backer NPCs. All the designs of the 10 NPCs have been finalized and are currently going through animation process.

☕️ New Original Soundtracks in production + Soundtrack DLC in plans:
The Original Soundtrack for Tailside already started production early November and currently we have a total of 7 tracks to be included in the game and Soundtrack DLC. This is expected to continue expand.

☕️ Game decorations already reached over 100 items
For EA, there is around 200 items promised as decor for your cafe zones and we are moving fast to reaching it - there's already over 100 items done for you to discover.

☕️ Keybinding & Controller Support
Added keybinding for keyboard & mouse and gamepad gameplay controls. Gamepad option is currently in testing and will be coming to EA.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/8a7475c431d48861f20a338432db2a17212b34b9.png

🛠️ Other edits & fixes:

 Closing and opening the brewing panel will now continue with the progress that was left instead of restarting completely
 Skip to LV10 (Skip introduction) has been added
 Time and day system has been added
 Cafe working hours has been added
 Settings option to toggle between run/walk instead of holding down the button
 Added soundtracks between different zones and different times of the day
 Started adding some more UI animations to make it feel more immersive and interactive
 In build mode, hovered on items will now have an outline for better visibility
 Settings option to turn off camera motion following
 Latte challenge mode toggle moved to settings
 Latte art is now randomized to 3 selectable options for each latte order
 Some timed and goal activities for brewing has been added (top secret!)
 Build mode fixing to work between different scenes and zones so you can decorate accordingly
 Expanding recipe book with other features
 Adding new journal for tracking game progress, levels, character info and more


If you would like to be part of the development journey, you can vote on various ideas on:
Discord | Twitter | Instagram | Leave your own suggestions
Thank you so much for the support - Coffee Beans Dev

notes.title: Devlog #005 (August 2024)
notes.content:
🎮 A Month of Playtesting
August has been busy, with two playtest versions released and lots of small and large bugs fixed. We are getting closer to the finalized demo version of the game. Current playtest access will remain open, and the third and final playtest version is planned to be released in the first half of September.

🏆First Event Results
We wrapped up the Wholesome Games week with 3,000 new wishlist additions and have been added to the recommended curated games, which has so far brought in an additional 2,000 wishlists, bringing us to over 18,000 total wishlists at the time of this post! Our coffee & cozy games community just keeps growing.

🎁Upcoming fundraiser
The next exciting step for Tailside is our upcoming fundraiser launch! This campaign will help us cover development costs until Early Access and may even allow us to add some extra features through stretch goals. As a special thank you for your early support, our fundraiser will feature an exclusive woodland-themed decor set, pet, and main character color—available only through this campaign.

📓 Let's Recap a Month of Work
Here is a recap of everything that has been added and fixed during this month of playtesting:

☕️ Recipe book
Added a recipe book to review various coffee-making steps.

Several settings related to music and dialogue adjustments have been added.

☕️ Improved customer system
Customers now enter with a coin, place a coffee order, take it, and leave a bit of a mess (empty cups) around. Tiny customers might jump on the tables if there is space!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/afca3e4c14016146f475adfe552b07127f2660fc.gif

Build mode now has an option to toggle grid snap.

Items will now be placed as previewed rather than "dropping down."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/69fc2a112e63f4624549d1f15b7d5109d4a0f842.gif

☕️ Quicker coffee making
Separated the grinding, brewing, and milk heating processes so that all of them can be done simultaneously.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/dc441544a0fbeecdd9dc054700a86c4767cbba0b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/95b183fb24e1ab237c794bebd82c263027291db7.gif

Coffee bean sorting will now be done periodically once the coffee beans bar decreases. The mess of empty cups will now affect the number of customers coming to the café.

 Minor floor art fixes

notes.title: Tailside in Wholesome Games
notes.content:
It's only the beginning of the month and exciting news just keep rolling out.

☕️ I’m thrilled to announce that Tailside will be included in the Wholesome Games event here on Steam from August 15-21st!

Wholesome Games is an event that features world premiere game announcements, discounts, demos, and launches of new, heartwarming games worth checking out.

Tailside is a cozy café game that invites you to unwind with adorable animal characters, café decor, and coffee brewing. It’s the perfect stop to relax.

This event marks a significant milestone for Tailside as it’s our first official participation in a major gaming event. I believe this will be a great opportunity to expand our cozy community and share the charm of Tailside with more players.

During the Wholesome Games event, Tailside's playtest will be available for everyone to try out directly through Tailside's Steam page. Simply request access, and the game will appear in your library immediately.

☕️ The playtest includes:

 Inside café area
 Coffee making
 Introduction of the first characters
 Café decoration options
 Tiny customers
 10 levels
 20 minutes of gameplay
 Plenty of hints for further updates

My main goal for this event is to get more eyes on Tailside and see our community grow and get further feedback on the game itself. I’m incredibly excited to see how it goes and can’t wait to welcome all the new members joining us.

Stay tuned for more updates and be sure to join us during the Wholesome Games event!

notes.title: Devlog #001 (April 2024)
notes.content:
After achieveming a big milestone of publishing the Steam page of Tailside, gathering 1000+ wishlists in 3 days and 2000+ within 2 weeks, we are now ready to start publishing more of work and behind the scenes of this little cozy cafe game.

This month we started creating new artwork, scenes and dialogues to the introductionary story of Tailside and some improvements on current gameplay, here is a quick breakdown:

🌱 Outside assets completed:
For your pleasure of wondering around the world of Tailside, we have completed art assets to start building the forests, trails and new scenes outside the cafe itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e1260b72403ac311560a51343d272821ef680e41.png

🌱 New campsite scene added:
Everyone loves a good camping evening with shared stories and nicely cooked marshmallows. It's probably a place you will keep finding yourself in with your newly made friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/6ce9b2dd139addc7bad5a7e2e8b0abd33907f151.png

☕️ Expanded build mode:
Build mode (cafe decoration) has now been expanded and split into shop + inventory system for a more convenient and organized way of purchasing decorations and making the cafe look the way you want it! Yes, it's fully customizable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e2c908b30e2d523e2465e28397e11c2c5d120e7c.png

🎨 Collaboration of the month:
This month we have revealed a collaboration for decorative plant assets for your personalized cafe with Grigoreen. These plants will be available in the cafe decoration shop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/ea3e57f446eb7aad6c2caa7abe0e43e23990506d.png

🛠️ Minor edits:

 Fixed coffee brewing panel to have sized up view for better playability.


🌻 Coming next:

 Garden area (outside of cafe)
 Build mode expansion (decor categories)
 Coffee brewing improvements (upgrades)
 Better visuals with lightning and shadows for night and day moods!
